free_tier.stated: free registration under the suffixes .DPDNS.ORG, .US.KG, .QZZ.IO, .XX.KG and .QD.JE, with the user's own authoritative nameservers entered in the dashboard; the default limit is 1 domain per user account

per_object_cap.stated: 1 domain per user account by default; sub-subdomains under the assigned name are made at the user's DNS provider

retention.stated: the dashboard is the source of truth for status and expiration date; renewal windows, fees and slot rules are not stated on the pages read and are said to change

egress.terms: no query cap published; the service holds no zone, so queries go to the user's chosen DNS provider

interface_detail: a web dashboard at dash.domain.digitalplat.org that needs an account (unverified: behind a sign-up); the tutorial has an API chapter whose content was not read. The service stores only the delegation: A, CNAME, MX and TXT records are managed at the external DNS service the nameservers name
tooling: the DigitalPlat dashboard, then an external authoritative DNS service of the user's choice
chaining: the delegation can point at an external DNS service such as Cloudflare, which makes the name a zone of the registrant's; the suffix is on the Public Suffix List

limits.value: the default limit is 1 domain per user account

supported suffixes, registration pauses, slot requirements, prices and limits change, and a registration may consume a slot or create a charge; a third-party report says .US.KG and .XX.KG paused new registrations and .QZZ.IO went paid-only, while the repository still lists them

binding_note: 1 domain per account is the stated cap, and the operator reserves registration pauses and slot or charge requirements per suffix; the zone is the registrant's through delegation, and the suffix listing keeps the TLS limit per name

identity_cost.detail: the account tutorial's preparation list names an email address, a name, a valid phone number in the format the form requests and a complete contact address; the dashboard registration form itself was not read: unverified whether the phone is checked by a code

reliability_note: the operator can pause a suffix, change slots or charges, or suspend a domain, and a third party reports two suffixes paused and one gone paid-only
confidence_note: the repository README, FAQ and tutorial pages were read and quoted; the dashboard answered a login wall, so the live registration form, the current slot rule and the renewal terms are unverified; the suffix status report is third-party

evidence.proved: the default limit is 1 domain per user account
evidence.quote: Currently, the default limit is 1 domain per user account.

evidence.proved: sub-subdomains are made at the user's DNS provider under the assigned name

evidence.proved: the account needs a valid phone number among its contact data
evidence.quote: A valid phone number in the format requested by the form

evidence.proved: a registration may consume a slot or create a charge
evidence.quote: Registration can create external state and may consume a slot or create a charge.

evidence.quote: Supported suffixes, registration pauses, slot requirements, prices, limits, renewal windows, and policies may change.

evidence.proved: a third-party post reports .qzz.io moved to paid-only
evidence.quote: `.qzz.io`**, also run under the DigitalPlat umbrella, moved to paid-only.

evidence.proved: DigitalPlat's suffixes (qzz.io, us.kg, xx.kg, dpdns.org) are entries of the private section of the Public Suffix List
Let's Encrypt finds the registered domain with the Public Suffix List
evidence.quote: We use the [Public Suffix List](https://publicsuffix.org/) to identify registered domains.

notes: The zone is the registrant's: the service stores only NS delegation, so a Cloudflare zone or any DNS host can serve it. The operator can still withdraw it, because a suffix can be paused, put behind a slot or charge, or a domain suspended. The TLS limit does not bind, because the suffixes are listed and each name counts alone. The dashboard is behind a login wall, so the live slot and renewal rules are unverified.
